data.description:
# File engine-move smells as high-priority items — CG-0MTCOQIRQ00541EJ

## Summary
Create high-priority child Worklog items for every engine-move candidate triaged in detection, with target-module tagging and REFACTOR comments.

## Goal
As an engine maintainer and game developer, logic that could be promoted into src/ engine modules is flagged high priority with target module indicated so extraction can be scheduled first.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. For each triaged finding flagged engine-move, one child work item created under CG-0MTCOQIRQ00541EJ with priority: high and tag indicating target module (engine-move:ui, engine-move:rule-engine, engine-move:core-engine, engine-move:card-system, engine-move:ai); description includes severity, file:line, smell type, duplication evidence, and proposed engine location.
2. REFACTOR comment injected at each source location (smell, severity, description, engine-move target) to prevent re-filing.
3. No duplication of prior closed smell items (6 IDs) unless regressed — with regression evidence and citation.
4. High-priority items are separable from non-engine-move items for scheduling (queryable via priority or tag); epic comment lists them separately.
5. Detection inventory engine-move subset fully drained — every candidate becomes a child or an explicit wont-file with rationale.

## Minimal Implementation
- Iterate triaged inventory engine-move subset; for each: wl create --parent CG-0MTCOQIRQ00541EJ --priority high --tags engine-move:<module> with detailed description; inject REFACTOR comment including engine-move target.
- Deduplicate against REFACTOR baseline and prior 6 IDs; record wont-file rationale for any filtered candidates.
- Verify parent linkage and priority/tag queryability (wl list or wl search).
- Epic comment: separate table of high-priority engine-move child IDs with target modules.

## Dependencies
Depends on Hybrid smell detection: engine modules and Hybrid smell detection: example games & tests; may run in parallel with non-engine-move filing after detection is complete.

## Deliverables
- High-priority child work items for engine-move smells under epic (priority high, tagged)
- REFACTOR comments injected at source with engine-move target
- Epic comment with high-priority child IDs + target modules

**Key Files:**
- `~/.pi/agent/skills/refactor/workitem_creation.py` — work item creation helpers
- `~/.pi/agent/skills/refactor/comment_injection.py` — REFACTOR comment injection
  Input: detection inventory artefact (engine-move subset)
- `src/ui/index.ts`, `src/rule-engine/index.ts`, `src/core-engine/index.ts` — candidate target modules
